name: Anyway Agents (Anyway / Cenetrium Inc.)
tagline: Agent Wallet (USDC on Base) + SuperAPI x402 marketplace: agent pays per call under an owner-set per-transaction cap
status_notes: Active. Company also runs Anyway Business (MoR/payment links); FinCEN MSB registered. Marketing says 50+ (page) / 60+ (SKILL.md) APIs; public directory probe returned 37 providers / 193 paths, only 11 marked healthy at probe time. o11 has a vendor comparison post (o11.ai/blog/o11-vs-anyway).
backers: Sky9 Capital ('multimillion-dollar investment', per site banner)

pricing.subscription: none ('Free to start — no card required')
pricing.notes: Network fee sponsored by Anyway. Card-funded credits 'can't be withdrawn or refunded'. Org Credits used before wallet USDC. per_call_min from homepage demo prices ($0.001 calls).

spend_controls.notes: Per-signature (per-transaction) USDC cap enforced server-side; direct eth_sendTransaction blocked; owner-only policy changes via browser; key reset. Daily/total caps and allowlists not documented. Terms put scope/limit configuration on the user.

setup_steps_to_first_call: anyway init wallets --type agent (owner sets spending limit in browser)
Owner funds agent wallet (USDC) or buys Credits
strengths: Agent-owned wallet separated from main funds; direct sends blocked
Quote + confirm before signing in CLI
Can pay any x402 endpoint, not just its catalog
weaknesses: Small, partly unhealthy catalog (37 providers; 11 healthy at probe)
Only per-transaction cap documented — no cumulative budget
Crypto-first (USDC on Base); card credits non-refundable
No documented MCP server or BYO accounts

sources.claim: Per-tx cap, direct sends blocked, card credit non-refundable, traces, CLI, 50+ APIs, Sky9
60+ APIs; CLI flow; USDC on Base agent wallet
Per-signature cap server-side; key reset; network fee sponsored
Directory/info REST; CLI quote+confirm; policy rejection
